business_summary: Okamoto Glass Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells special-purpose glass for industrial use and multi-layer film evaporation products. The company operates through Optical Business, Lighting Business, Functional Thin Film and Glass Business, and Other segments. The Optical Business segment manufactures and sells fly-eye lenses and reflectors for digital cinema projectors. The Lighting Business segment manufactures and sells glass for automobile headlights, fog lights; and glass products for general lighting. The Functional Thin Film and Glass Business segment manufactures and sells durable silver mirrors; glass polarizers; and decorative deposition on glass containers, and liquid crystal displays in cockpits, as well as manufactures and sells vapor deposition onto surface glass and frit. It also produces glass products, such as dental mirrors, and door glass for washing machines. In addition, the company offers glass materials, glass molded items, optical/functional coating products, glass ball/ oceanic spacecraft products, glass powder, uv-filter, decoration, and other products. Its products are used in mobility, display, telecommunication, sensor/IOT, medical, illumination, energy, and infrastructure/residence applications. Okamoto Glass Co., Ltd. was founded in 1928 and is headquartered in Kashiwa, Japan.
